rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: pick_validator._self_heal_picks applies a reverse-stack adjustment that adds the Tennis ML learning_v2 bucket weight (currently negative ~-9 to -12%) to model_win_probability to recompute win_probability. For tennis_extra picks, win_probability is intentionally set equal to book-implied probability (no independent model exists for these Eastbourne/Mallorca/Bad Homburg scraped matches), so applying the negative bucket weight produced WP ≈ implied - 10%, which then computed as edge_percent ≈ -10%. That crushed lock_score and hid them from the surfacing filters. FIX: pick_validator.py now detects source in ('tennis_extra','tennis_extra_model') and (1) skips the reverse-stack WP adjustment (Step 2), and (2) forces edge_percent=0.0 (Step 3) since book-anchored picks have no real model edge. VERIFICATION: 4 picks (Davidovich Fokina, Quinn, Draper, Fery) now show edge=0.0, lock 91.5-91.9, and remain stable across multiple validator cycles. Fix verified permanent.
